correctness.rationale: Weighted difference coordinates identify the little spaces with c0-type sequence spaces; the multiplier rows are explicit, and finite-coordinate truncation plus norm-vanishing rows of compact perturbations gives the exact essential norm.

originality.rationale: The 2010 and 2013 tree papers and the 2026 infinite-graph paper give essential-norm estimates, while the 2026 c0-isometry paper gives exact operator norms but no essential-norm formula located in the inspected text. The claim remains to the best of our knowledge, with the 2016 Locke dissertation and a cited 2023 Colonna--Locke preprint as residual risks.

value.rationale: The theorem closes the essential-norm estimate gap on the little weighted tree space, yields an explicit harmonic-number formula in the classical weighted case, and extends the mechanism to arbitrary positive edge weights.
